rules.name: Iron Skin
rules.description: All damage taken is reduced by 25%.

rules.name: Regen Pheromones
rules.description: This unit and all nearby allies are healed for 1 health each turn.

rules.name: Depth Perception
rules.description: Height Advantage confers an additional +5 Aim and 5+ critical chance.

rules.name: Collateral Damage
rules.description: Area of effect attack that destroys most cover and hits all eligible targets for 34% damage. This attack cannot cause critical hits.

sharedRules.name: Aggression
sharedRules.description: Confers +10% critical chance per enemy in sight (Max +30%).

sharedRules.name: Airborne
sharedRules.description: Flying units can bypass ground obstacles. They can remain in flight if they have sufficient fuel.

sharedRules.name: Battle Scanner
sharedRules.description: Scanning device that, when thrown, creates a new source of vision for 2 turns. Can only be used 2 times per battle.

sharedRules.name: Blood Call
sharedRules.description: Unleash a bestial roar that inspires nearby allies of the same species to greater speed, focus, and resolve for 2 turns. 4 turn cooldown.

sharedRules.name: Bloodlust
sharedRules.description: Allows the Berserker to charge any enemy that wounds it.

sharedRules.name: Bombard
sharedRules.description: Throw or launch grenades over exceptionally long distances.

sharedRules.name: Bring 'Em On
sharedRules.description: Adds 1 damage on Critical hits for each enemy the squad can see (up to 5).

sharedRules.name: Bull Rush
sharedRules.description: Charge in a straight line through cover to unleash a devastating melee attack.

sharedRules.name: Bullet Swarm
sharedRules.description: Firing the primary weapon as the first action no longer ends the turn.

sharedRules.name: Close Combat Specialist
sharedRules.description: Confers a reaction shot against any enemy who closes to within 4 tiles. Does not require overwatch.

sharedRules.name: Combat Drugs
sharedRules.description: Smoke Grenades now contain powerful stimulants that grant +20 Will and +10 critical chance for all units in the cloud.

sharedRules.name: Covering Fire
sharedRules.description: Allows reaction shots to trigger on enemy attacks, not just movement.

sharedRules.name: Damn Good Ground
sharedRules.description: Confers +10 Aim and +10 Defense against enemies at lower elevation, in addition to the usual elevation bonuses.

sharedRules.name: Danger Zone
sharedRules.description: Increases AoE on Suppression and all rocket attacks by 2 tiles.

sharedRules.name: Death Blossom
sharedRules.description: Project an intense energy field from Closed position, damaging all nearby enemies. 3 turn cooldown.

sharedRules.name: Deep Pockets
sharedRules.description: All limited-use items in your inventory receive one extra use.

sharedRules.name: Dense Smoke
sharedRules.description: Smoke Grenades have increased area of effect and increase Defense by 40 instead of 20.

sharedRules.name: Disabling Shot
sharedRules.description: Allows the Sniper to fire a shot that causes the target's main weapon to malfunction. The target may use Reload to fix the weapon. The shot cannot inflict a critical hit. 2 turn cooldown.

sharedRules.name: Double Tap
sharedRules.description: Allows both actions to be used for Standard Shot, Headshot, or Disabling Shot, provided no moves were made. The second shot must be taken immediately after the first. 1 turn cooldown.

sharedRules.name: Electro Pulse
sharedRules.description: MECs can stun robotic enemies and damage organic ones with this area-of-effect electric shock device.

sharedRules.name: Evasion
sharedRules.description: Enemies targeting this unit when it is airborne suffer a -20 Aim penalty.

sharedRules.name: Executioner
sharedRules.description: Confers +10 Aim against targets with less than 50% health.

sharedRules.name: Extra Conditioning
sharedRules.description: Confers bonus health based on what type of armor is equipped. Heavier armor increases the bonus.

sharedRules.name: Field Medic
sharedRules.description: Allows medikits to be used 3 times per battle instead of once.

sharedRules.name: Fire Rocket
sharedRules.description: Fire a rocket using an equipped launcher. This ability cannot be used after moving, nor more than once per mission.

sharedRules.name: Flame Resistant
sharedRules.description: Cooling systems and alien alloy construction confer immunity to environmental fire damage.

sharedRules.name: Flamethrower
sharedRules.description: Allows MEC to lay waste to a cone-shaped area. Flame can spill outside the aiming area.

sharedRules.name: Flight
sharedRules.description: This armor is fitted with a jet pack that permits the wearer to fly for a limited period of time.

sharedRules.name: Ghost Mode
sharedRules.description: A Ghost Armor wearer can activate a special mode that makes him or her invisible to enemies.

sharedRules.name: Grapple
sharedRules.description: This armor mounts a grappling hook and cable on the left arm, permitting rapid elevation change and access to tactically advantageous positions.

sharedRules.name: Greater Mind Merge
sharedRules.description: Merge minds with all lesser allies of the same species nearby, granting them +25% critical chance and +1 health.

sharedRules.name: Grenade Launcher
sharedRules.description: MECs can make for their lack of thrown grenade capability with a long-range grenade launcher.

sharedRules.name: Grenadier
sharedRules.description: Allows 2 grenades in a single inventory slot. Frag, Alien, and Needle Grenades receive a +1 damage bonus.

sharedRules.name: Gunslinger
sharedRules.description: Confers 2 bonus damage with pistols.

sharedRules.name: Hardened
sharedRules.description: Hardened units receive extra protection against critical hits.

sharedRules.name: Headshot
sharedRules.description: Fire a shot with +30% critical chance and extra damage on critical hits, based on the tech level of the sniper rifle. 2 turn cool down.

sharedRules.name: HEAT Ammo
sharedRules.description: Confers +50% damage against robotic enemies.

sharedRules.name: Holo-Targeting
sharedRules.description: Shooting at or suppressing enemies also confers +10 Aim to any allies' attacks on those enemies.

sharedRules.name: Implant
sharedRules.description: Victims are implanted with a Chryssalid egg if they are killed by a Chryssalid's attack (not from poison caused by Poisonous Claws).

sharedRules.name: Intimidate
sharedRules.description: Reacts unpredictably when wounded, provoking panic in enemies.

sharedRules.name: Kinetic Strike Module
sharedRules.description: A powerful arm upgrade for the MEC, allowing the wielder to pulverize adjacent cover and enemies. Also boosts mobility.

sharedRules.name: Launch
sharedRules.description: Move anywhere on the battlefield in a single turn. Launch cannot be used indoors.

sharedRules.name: Leap
sharedRules.description: Allows vertical leaps onto elevated surfaces during movement.

sharedRules.name: Lightning Reflexes
sharedRules.description: Force the first reaction shot against this unit each turn to miss.

sharedRules.name: Low Profile
sharedRules.description: Makes partial cover count as full.

sharedRules.name: Mayhem
sharedRules.description: Confers additional damage based on weapon tech level to Suppression and all area-effect abilities.

sharedRules.name: Mind Control
sharedRules.description: Very difficult psi technique that, if successful, grants control of the target for 3 turns. Robotic enemies are immune. 5 turn cooldown.

sharedRules.name: Mind Merge
sharedRules.description: Merge minds with the target, granting the target +25% critical chance and +1 health.

sharedRules.name: Mindfray
sharedRules.description: Causes the target to lose grip on reality, inflicting penalties to Aim, Will and mobility, and doing 5 base damage. Robotic units are immune. Lasts 2 turns. 1 turn cooldown.

sharedRules.name: Opportunist
sharedRules.description: Eliminates the Aim penalty on reaction shots, and allows reaction shots to cause critical hits.

sharedRules.name: Overload
sharedRules.description: Overload the unit's own power source, destroying the unit but causing explosive damage similar to a grenade's.

sharedRules.name: Plasma Barrage
sharedRules.description: The Mechtoid can fire twice on the same turn if it doesn't move.

sharedRules.name: Poison Immunity
sharedRules.description: This unit is immune to the effects of poison.

sharedRules.name: Poison Spit
sharedRules.description: Spits a cloud of poison at long range, causing a noxious cloud to remain briefly on the battlefield.

sharedRules.name: Poisonous Claws
sharedRules.description: Poison enemies wounded with melee attacks.

sharedRules.name: Proximity Mine Launcher
sharedRules.description: Proximity mines can be deployed at medium range, and will await nearby enemy movement before triggering their explosive charges.

sharedRules.name: Psi Inspiration
sharedRules.description: Removes Mindfray and panic from all allies within 3 tiles, and strengthens their Will by +30 for 2 turns. 4 turn cooldown.

sharedRules.name: Psi Lance
sharedRules.description: Project a bolt of pure psi force at an enemy.

sharedRules.name: Psi Panic
sharedRules.description: Cause target to panic on its following turn, if the target's Will is overcome. Robotic enemies are immune. 2 turn cooldown.

sharedRules.name: Psi-Drain
sharedRules.description: Drain health from an ally.

sharedRules.name: Rapid Fire
sharedRules.description: Take two shots against a single target in quick succession. Each shot carries a -15 penalty to Aim.

sharedRules.name: Rapid Reaction
sharedRules.description: Confers a second reaction shot if on Overwatch and the first reaction shot is a hit.

sharedRules.name: Repair
sharedRules.description: Repairs robotic units.

sharedRules.name: Resilience
sharedRules.description: Confers immunity to critical hits.

sharedRules.name: Restorative Mist
sharedRules.description: Medikits require fine motor control; instead, the MEC can spray Restorative Mist to heal all nearby allies.

sharedRules.name: Revive
sharedRules.description: Allows medikits to revive critically wounded soldiers at 33% of max health, instead of just stabilizing them.

sharedRules.name: Rift
sharedRules.description: Devastate an area with a storm of psi energy. The rift does more damage against targets with low Will, and reduced damage against targets with high Will. 4 turn cooldown.

sharedRules.name: Robotic
sharedRules.description: Immune to fire, poison, and several Psionic abilities.

sharedRules.name: Run & Gun
sharedRules.description: Allows to fire or enter Overwatch after dashing.

sharedRules.name: Sealed
sharedRules.description: Internal air supply and recycling systems provide the wearer immunity to poison and airway interruption.

sharedRules.name: Sentinel
sharedRules.description: Allows two reaction shots during Overwatch instead of one.

sharedRules.name: Shredder Rocket
sharedRules.description: Fire a rocket that causes all enemies hit to take +33% damage from all sources for the next 4 turns. However, this rocket has a weaker blast compared to a normal one.

sharedRules.name: Smoke and Mirrors
sharedRules.description: Allows 2 additional uses of Smoke Grenade each mission.

sharedRules.name: Smoke Grenade
sharedRules.description: Deploy a smoke grenade once per mission. The smoke confers +20 Defense to all units, and lasts through the enemy turn.

sharedRules.name: Snap Shot
sharedRules.description: Removes the sniper rifle's restriction on firing and Overwatch after moving. Any shots taken suffer a -10 Aim penalty.

sharedRules.name: Sprinter
sharedRules.description: Allows the Support to move 3 additional tiles.

sharedRules.name: Squadsight
sharedRules.description: Allows firing at targets in any ally's sight radius, but these targets cannot be critically hit unless using Headshot.

sharedRules.name: Stealth
sharedRules.description: The seeker becomes invisible to enemies. It can use its tentacles to attack from stealth mode, but must deactivate stealth mode to use its ranged attack.

sharedRules.name: Strangle
sharedRules.description: Strangle can be used against adjacent humans unprotected by strangle-resistant armor, items, or abilities.

sharedRules.name: Suppression
sharedRules.description: Can fire a special shot that grants reaction fire at a single target. The target also suffers a -30 Aim penalty.

sharedRules.name: Tactical Sense
sharedRules.description: +5 Defense per enemy in sight (Max +20)

sharedRules.name: Telekinetic Field
sharedRules.description: Create an immobile telekinetic field that lasts through the enemy turn. The field distorts and deflects incoming attacks, granting +40 Defense to both allies and enemies within the field. 4 turn cooldown.

sharedRules.name: Will to Survive
sharedRules.description: Reduces normal damage taken by 2 if in cover and not flanked.

rules.name: Adrenal Neurosympathy
rules.description: Overloads the soldiers adrenal glands: when a kill is confirmed the soldier emits pheromones that grant offensive benefits to all nearby squad mates. Cannot occur more than once on every 5 turns.

rules.name: Hyper Reactive Pupils
rules.description: Confers +10 Aim to any shot after a miss.

rules.name: Mimetic Skin
rules.description: Confers the ability to change skin pattern to match cover. When a soldier moves to high cover, enemies without special abilities will not target soldier. Does not work if any enemies have line of sight to the soldier's starting position. Leaving cover or firing will break this concealment.

rules.name: Muscle Fiber Density
rules.description: Confers superhuman leg strength, enabling the soldier to reach high positions without the need for ladders or other climbing aids.

rules.name: Hyper Reactive Pupils
rules.description: Confers +10 Aim to any shot after a miss.

rules.name: Bioelectric Skin
rules.description: The soldier projects an electric skin from his or her skin, revealing but not alerting nearby enemies, and is immune to strangulation.

rules.name: Neural Feedback
rules.description: Causes damage to psi attackers and puts all of their psi attacks on cooldown. Does not reduce the attacker's chance of success.

rules.name: Adaptive Bone Marrow
rules.description: Wound recovery time is reduced by 66%. Soldier regenerates 2 HP per turn up to the HP max without armor.

rules.name: Depth Perception
rules.description: Height Advantage confers an additional +5 Aim and 5+ critical chance.

rules.name: Muscle Fiber Density
rules.description: Confers superhuman leg strength, enabling the soldier to reach high positions without the need for ladders or other climbing aids.
